name: luxora-nova-website
description: Corporate website for LUXORA NOVA TRADING - FZCO

scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client
